notes.text:
Implementation contract (short):

- Requirement -> owning files (high level)
  - Window title (0): main.gd
  - Player mouse visual & movement (1,4,5,6,15 spin on death): mouse.gd, main.gd
  - Maze 15x15, walls, crumbs, eat logic (2,7,8,9,19 win): maze.gd, crumb.gd, main.gd
  - Cats chasing & collisions (10,11,12,13,14): cat.gd, main.gd, maze.gd
  - UI: score/lives and win/lose text, prints (20,21,22): ui.gd, main.gd
  - Level editor preview (17,18): level_editor.tscn/gd -> instantiates Main with provided maze array
  - Project entry (project.godot, main.tscn): project.godot, main.tscn

- State ownership
  - Maze (maze.gd): owns grid data (Array[Array]), walls, crumb node instances, coordinate conversions.
    Interfaces: is_open(tile: Vector2) -> bool, tile_to_pos(tile: Vector2) -> Vector2, eat_crumb(tile: Vector2) -> bool
  - Main (main.gd): owns game_state ('playing','won','over'), score:int, lives:int, start positions; spawns Maze, Mouse and Cats and UI; handles restart/quit.
    Interfaces: register_crumb_eaten(tile: Vector2), on_mouse_caught()
  - Mouse (mouse.gd): owns movement intent/current_target, tile index; signals Main on arrival at tile and on collision attempt.
    Interfaces: set_start(tile: Vector2), _process handles smooth movement; emits "caught" by calling main.on_mouse_caught()
  - Cat (cat.gd): owns its own tile and movement; queries maze.is_open and reads Mouse.tile to pick direction at junctions.

- Coordinate convention
  - Logical tile: Vector2(x:int, y:int), 0..14. tile_to_pos returns center pixel position (Vector2) where origin places grid centered within 800x600 viewport. tile_size = 32.

- Input -> action -> state -> feedback
  - InputMap actions: "turn_up","turn_down","turn_left","turn_right","restart","quit".
  - On arrow press: main prints "TURN UP" etc, calls mouse.set_intended_dir(dir). Mouse will change direction at next tile center if possible; movement visually interpolates between tile centers and applies squash-stretch via scale change.
  - On crumb eaten: Maze.eat_crumb returns true; Main increments score by 10, UI updated, crumb spawns sparkle animation (in Crumb.gd).
  - On collision: when cat.tile == mouse.tile -> Main.on_mouse_caught() reduces lives, prints, triggers spin-and-fade (mouse animates), resets positions; if lives==0 -> GAME OVER state and prints "GAME OVER" and freezes movement.
  - On all crumbs eaten: Main prints "WIN", freezes movement.

- Lifecycle
  - init: Main._ready builds Maze, Mouse, two Cats, and UI. Places mouse at start tile with at least two adjacent open tiles.
  - play: game_state == 'playing': _process updates movement.
  - terminal: when 'won' or 'over' movement stops; R triggers restart to initial state (3 lives, score 0, all crumbs restored), Escape quits (prints QUIT and get_tree().quit()).
  - reset: Main.reset() re-creates maze crumbs, restores positions and counters.

Now I will write the promised files.

+extends Node2D
+class_name Mouse
+
+signal ate_crumb(tile)
+signal caught()
+
+const TILE_SIZE := 32
+const MOVE_SPEED := 6.0 # tiles per second
+
+var maze: Maze = null
+var tile := Vector2.ZERO
+var target_tile := Vector2.ZERO
+var moving := false
+var direction := Vector2.ZERO
+var intended := Vector2.ZERO
+var progress := 0.0
+var active := true
+
+func setup(_maze, start_tile: Vector2) -> void:
+    maze = _maze
+    tile = start_tile
+    position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+    direction = Vector2.ZERO
+    intended = Vector2.ZERO
+    moving = false
+    progress = 0.0
+    scale = Vector2.ONE
+
+func set_intended_direction(d: Vector2) -> void:
+    intended = d
+
+func set_active(a: bool) -> void:
+    active = a
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if not active:
+        return
+    if not is_inside_tree():
+        return
+    if not moving:
+        # try to start moving in intended direction first
+        if intended != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + intended):
+            direction = intended
+        elif direction != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + direction):
+            # continue
+            pass
+        else:
+            direction = Vector2.ZERO
+        if direction != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + direction):
+            moving = true
+            target_tile = tile + direction
+            progress = 0.0
+    else:
+        # move towards target
+        var move_time := 1.0 / MOVE_SPEED
+        progress += delta / move_time
+        if progress > 1.0:
+            # Arrived
+            tile = target_tile
+            position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+            moving = false
+            progress = 0.0
+            # Check crumb
+            if maze.eat_crumb(tile):
+                emit_signal("ate_crumb", tile)
+            # Check collision with cats by asking parent
+            for c in get_parent().get_children():
+                if c is Cat:
+                    if c.tile == tile:
+                        emit_signal("caught")
+            # After arriving, try to turn to intended direction immediately
+            if intended != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + intended):
+                direction = intended
+                moving = true
+                target_tile = tile + direction
+                progress = 0.0
+        else:
+            # interpolate position
+            var a = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+            var b = maze.tile_to_pos(target_tile)
+            position = a.linear_interpolate(b, progress)
+            # squash and stretch animation
+            var s := 1.0 + 0.15 * sin(progress * PI)
+            scale = Vector2(1.0/s, s)
+            # Check for instantaneous collision with cats during slide
+            for c in get_parent().get_children():
+                if c is Cat:
+                    # if cat occupies same tile approximation
+                    if c.tile == tile or c.tile == target_tile:
+                        var catpos = c.position
+                        if position.distance_to(catpos) < 8:
+                            emit_signal("caught")
+
+func respawn(start_tile: Vector2) -> void:
+    # play spin and fade
+    # simple instant reset for now with brief pause
+    position = maze.tile_to_pos(start_tile)
+    tile = start_tile
+    direction = Vector2.ZERO
+    intended = Vector2.ZERO
+    moving = false
+    scale = Vector2.ONE
+    # notify parent that respawn done (parent already manages lives)
+

--- game/maze.gd
+++ game/maze.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name Maze
+
+const WIDTH := 15
+const HEIGHT := 15
+const TILE_SIZE := 32
+
+var walls := []
+var crumbs := {} # Dictionary keyed by Vector2 -> Crumb
+var crumb_count := 0
+var offset := Vector2.ZERO
+
+onready var CrumbScene = preload("res://crumb.gd")
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # center the grid in 800x600 (as planned)
+    var grid_px = Vector2(WIDTH * TILE_SIZE, HEIGHT * TILE_SIZE)
+    offset = Vector2((800 - grid_px.x) / 2, (600 - grid_px.y) / 2)
+    build_default()
+    update()
+
+func build_default() -> void:
+    # create walls array and place walls around border and a simple pattern
+    walls = []
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        var row := []
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            var is_wall := false
+            # border walls
+            if x == 0 or y == 0 or x == WIDTH - 1 or y == HEIGHT - 1:
+                is_wall = true
+            # simple inner pattern: walls on even coords except near start (1,1)
+            elif x % 2 == 0 and y % 2 == 0:
+                is_wall = true
+            row.append(is_wall)
+        walls.append(row)
+    # Carve some passages to ensure start area open
+    walls[1][1] = false
+    walls[2][1] = false
+    walls[1][2] = false
+    # Remove a few more to make playable
+    walls[3][1] = false
+    walls[3][2] = false
+    walls[5][1] = false
+    # create crumbs on every open tile
+    _create_crumbs()
+
+func build_from_layout(layout:Array) -> void:
+    # layout expected as Array of Array of int (1 wall, 0 open)
+    if layout.size() != HEIGHT:
+        build_default()
+        return
+    walls = []
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        var row := []
+        var layrow = layout[y]
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            var is_wall = false
+            if int(layrow[x]) == 1:
+                is_wall = true
+            row.append(is_wall)
+        walls.append(row)
+    _create_crumbs()
+    update()
+
+func _create_crumbs() -> void:
+    # clear existing crumbs
+    for k in crumbs.keys():
+        var c = crumbs[k]
+        if is_instance_valid(c):
+            c.queue_free()
+    crumbs.clear()
+    crumb_count = 0
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            if not walls[y][x]:
+                var tile = Vector2(x, y)
+                var c = Crumb.new()
+                c.tile = tile
+                add_child(c)
+                c.position = tile_to_pos(tile)
+                crumbs[tile] = c
+                crumb_count += 1
+
+func reset() -> void:
+    # rebuild crumbs but keep walls
+    _create_crumbs()
+    update()
+
+func is_open(tile:Vector2) -> bool:
+    var x = int(tile.x)
+    var y = int(tile.y)
+    if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= WIDTH or y >= HEIGHT:
+        return false
+    return not walls[y][x]
+
+func tile_to_pos(tile:Vector2) -> Vector2:
+    return offset + Vector2(tile.x * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE / 2, tile.y * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE / 2)
+
+func eat_crumb(tile:Vector2) -> bool:
+    # called when mouse arrives at tile
+    if crumbs.has(tile):
+        var c = crumbs[tile]
+        if is_instance_valid(c):

+extends Node2D
+class_name LevelEditor
+
+const WIDTH := 15
+const HEIGHT := 15
+const TILE_SIZE := 32
+
+var walls := []
+var offset := Vector2.ZERO
+var preview_node := null
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    var grid_px = Vector2(WIDTH * TILE_SIZE, HEIGHT * TILE_SIZE)
+    offset = Vector2((800 - grid_px.x) / 2, (600 - grid_px.y) / 2)
+    # initialize walls as 0 (open)
+    walls = []
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        var row := []
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            row.append(0)
+        walls.append(row)
+    set_process_input(true)
+    update()
+    # instructions label
+    var lbl = Label.new()
+    lbl.text = "Click to toggle walls. Press P to preview/stop preview."
+    add_child(lbl)
+    lbl.position = Vector2(10, 10)
+
+func _input(event) -> void:
+    if event is InputEventMouseButton and event.pressed and not event.doubleclick:
+        var mp = get_local_mouse_position()
+        var local = mp - offset
+        var tx = int(local.x / TILE_SIZE)
+        var ty = int(local.y / TILE_SIZE)
+        if tx >= 0 and ty >= 0 and tx < WIDTH and ty < HEIGHT:
+            walls[ty][tx] = 1 - int(walls[ty][tx])
+            update()
+    if event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo:
+        if event.physical_keycode == KEY_P:
+            # toggle preview
+            if preview_node and is_instance_valid(preview_node):
+                preview_node.queue_free()
+                preview_node = null
+            else:
+                print("PREVIEW")
+                var packed = load("res://main.tscn")
+                if packed:
+                    preview_node = packed.instantiate()
+                    add_child(preview_node)
+                    # convert walls (0/1) to layout array of ints
+                    var layout := []
+                    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+                        var row := []
+                        for x in range(WIDTH):
+                            row.append(int(walls[y][x]))
+                        layout.append(row)
+                    preview_node.call_deferred("set_layout", layout)
+        elif event.physical_keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
+            # stop preview if any
+            if preview_node and is_instance_valid(preview_node):
+                preview_node.queue_free()
+                preview_node = null
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+    # draw grid and walls
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            var pos = Vector2(offset.x + x * TILE_SIZE, offset.y + y * TILE_SIZE)
+            var rect = Rect2(pos, Vector2(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE))
+            if int(walls[y][x]) == 1:
+                draw_rect(rect, Color(0.2,0.2,0.2))
+            else:
+                draw_rect(rect, Color(0.95,0.95,0.95))
+    # grid lines
+    for y in range(HEIGHT + 1):
+        var start = Vector2(offset.x, offset.y + y * TILE_SIZE)
+        var end = Vector2(offset.x + WIDTH * TILE_SIZE, offset.y + y * TILE_SIZE)
+        draw_line(start, end, Color(0.7,0.7,0.7), 1)
+    for x in range(WIDTH + 1):
+        var start = Vector2(offset.x + x * TILE_SIZE, offset.y)
+        var end = Vector2(offset.x + x * TILE_SIZE, offset.y + HEIGHT * TILE_SIZE)
+        draw_line(start, end, Color(0.7,0.7,0.7), 1)
+
+func get_layout() -> Array:
+    var layout := []
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        var row := []
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            row.append(int(walls[y][x]))
+        layout.append(row)
+    return layout

# Main game controller

# We'll load scripts at runtime to avoid parse-time class resolution issues

var maze = null
var mouse: Node = null

var ui: Node = null

var lives := 3

func _ready() -> void:
    DisplayServer.window_set_title("Crumb Chase")
    _setup_input()
    _start_game()

func _setup_input() -> void:
    # add InputMap actions
    var a := InputMap.has_action("turn_up")
    InputMap.add_action("turn_up")
    var e = InputEventKey.new()
    e.physical_keycode = KEY_UP
    InputMap.action_add_event("turn_up", e)
    var e2 = InputEventKey.new()
    e2.physical_keycode = KEY_W
    InputMap.action_add_event("turn_up", e2)

    InputMap.add_action("turn_down")
    var d = InputEventKey.new(); d.physical_keycode = KEY_DOWN; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_down", d)
    var d2 = InputEventKey.new(); d2.physical_keycode = KEY_S; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_down", d2)

    InputMap.add_action("turn_left")
    var l = InputEventKey.new(); l.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_left", l)
    var l2 = InputEventKey.new(); l2.physical_keycode = KEY_A; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_left", l2)

    InputMap.add_action("turn_right")
    var r = InputEventKey.new(); r.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_right", r)
    var r2 = InputEventKey.new(); r2.physical_keycode = KEY_D; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_right", r2)

    InputMap.add_action("restart")
    var re = InputEventKey.new(); re.physical_keycode = KEY_R; InputMap.action_add_event("restart", re)

    InputMap.add_action("quit")
    var q = InputEventKey.new(); q.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE; InputMap.action_add_event("quit", q)

func _start_game() -> void:
    # create maze
    maze = MazeScene.new()
    add_child(maze)
    # create mouse
    mouse = Mouse.new()
    add_child(mouse)
    mouse.setup(maze, mouse_start)
    mouse.connect("ate_crumb", Callable(self, "_on_mouse_ate_crumb"))
    mouse.connect("caught", Callable(self, "_on_mouse_caught"))
    # create cats
    cats = []
    for i in range(2):
        var c = Cat.new()
        add_child(c)
        c.setup(maze, cat_starts[i], mouse)
        cats.append(c)
    # ui
    ui = UI.new()
    add_child(ui)
    ui.update(score, lives)
    game_state = "playing"

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    if game_state != "playing":
        return
    # handle input
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_up"):
        print("TURN UP")
        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(0, -1))
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_down"):
        print("TURN DOWN")
        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(0, 1))
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_left"):
        print("TURN LEFT")
        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(-1, 0))
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_right"):
        print("TURN RIGHT")
        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(1, 0))
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        print("RESTART")
        restart_game()
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        print("QUIT")
        get_tree().quit()

func _on_mouse_ate_crumb(tile: Vector2) -> void:
    score += 10
    ui.update(score, lives)
    # check win
    if maze.get_crumb_count() == 0:
        _on_win()

func _on_mouse_caught() -> void:
    lives -= 1
    ui.update(score, lives)
    # respawn animation placeholder: make mouse spin by rotating and fading via modulate

func setup(_maze, start_tile: Vector2) -> void:
    maze = _maze
    tile = start_tile
    target_tile = tile
    position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)

    intended = Vector2.ZERO
    moving = false

    active = true
    scale = Vector2.ONE

func set_intended_direction(d: Vector2) -> void:
    intended = d

func set_active(a: bool) -> void:
    active = a

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    if not active:
        return
    if not is_inside_tree():
        return

    # decide direction if not moving
    if not moving:
        if intended != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + intended):
            direction = intended
        elif direction != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + direction):
            # continue in same direction
            pass
        else:
            direction = Vector2.ZERO

        if direction != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + direction):
            moving = true
            target_tile = tile + direction
            progress = 0.0
            return

    # if moving, advance along the tile
    if moving:

        progress += delta / move_time

            moving = false

    # add InputMap actions
    var a := InputMap.has_action("turn_up")
    InputMap.add_action("turn_up")
    var e = InputEventKey.new()
    e.physical_keycode = KEY_UP
    InputMap.action_add_event("turn_up", e)
    var e2 = InputEventKey.new()
    e2.physical_keycode = KEY_W
    InputMap.action_add_event("turn_up", e2)

    InputMap.add_action("turn_down")
    var d = InputEventKey.new(); d.physical_keycode = KEY_DOWN; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_down", d)
    var d2 = InputEventKey.new(); d2.physical_keycode = KEY_S; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_down", d2)

    InputMap.add_action("turn_left")
    var l = InputEventKey.new(); l.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_left", l)
    var l2 = InputEventKey.new(); l2.physical_keycode = KEY_A; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_left", l2)

    InputMap.add_action("turn_right")
    var r = InputEventKey.new(); r.physical_keycode = KEY_RIGHT; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_right", r)
    var r2 = InputEventKey.new(); r2.physical_keycode = KEY_D; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_right", r2)

    InputMap.add_action("restart")
    var re = InputEventKey.new(); re.physical_keycode = KEY_R; InputMap.action_add_event("restart", re)

    InputMap.add_action("quit")
    var q = InputEventKey.new(); q.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE; InputMap.action_add_event("quit", q)

func _start_game() -> void:
    # create maze by attaching the script to a Node2D so CanvasItem methods exist
    var maze_node = Node2D.new()
    maze_node.set_script(load("res://maze.gd"))
    add_child(maze_node)
    maze = maze_node

    # create mouse
    var mouse_node = Node2D.new()
    mouse_node.set_script(load("res://mouse.gd"))
    add_child(mouse_node)
    mouse = mouse_node
    mouse.setup(maze, mouse_start)
    mouse.connect("ate_crumb", Callable(self, "_on_mouse_ate_crumb"))
    mouse.connect("caught", Callable(self, "_on_mouse_caught"))

    # create cats
    cats = []
    for i in range(2):
        var cnode = Node2D.new()
        cnode.set_script(load("res://cat.gd"))
        add_child(cnode)
        var c = cnode
        c.setup(maze, cat_starts[i], mouse)
        cats.append(c)

    # ui
    var uinode = CanvasLayer.new()
    uinode.set_script(load("res://ui.gd"))
    add_child(uinode)
    ui = uinode
    ui.update(score, lives)

    if game_state != "playing":

    # handle input
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_up"):

        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(0, -1))
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_down"):
        print("TURN DOWN")
        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(0, 1))
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_left"):
        print("TURN LEFT")
        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(-1, 0))
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_right"):
        print("TURN RIGHT")
        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(1, 0))
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):
        print("RESTART")
        restart_game()
    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("quit"):
        print("QUIT")
        get_tree().quit()

func _on_mouse_ate_crumb(tile: Vector2) -> void:
    score += 10
    ui.update(score, lives)
    # check win
    if maze.get_crumb_count() == 0:
        _on_win()

func _on_mouse_caught() -> void:
    lives -= 1
    ui.update(score, lives)
    # respawn animation placeholder: make mouse spin by rotating and fading via modulate
    mouse.set_active(false)
    for c in cats:
        c.set_active(false)
    # simple immediate respawn
    if lives <= 0:
        _on_game_over()
    else:
        # reset positions
        mouse.respawn(mouse_start)
        for i in range(cats.size()):
            cats[i].respawn(cat_starts[i])
        mouse.set_active(true)
        for c in cats:
            c.set_active(true)

func _on_win() -> void:
    game_state = "won"
    ui.show_end("WIN", score)
    print("WIN")

func _on_game_over() -> void:
    game_state = "over"
    ui.show_end("GAME OVER", score)
    print("GAME OVER")

func restart_game() -> void:
    # restore initial state
    score = 0
    lives = 3
    maze.reset()
    mouse.respawn(mouse_start)
    for i in range(cats.size()):
        cats[i].respawn(cat_starts[i])
    ui.update(score, lives)
    ui.end_label.visible = false
    game_state = "playing"

    maze.build_from_layout(layout)
    # reposition characters if necessary
    mouse.respawn(mouse_start)
    for i in range(cats.size()):
        cats[i].respawn(cat_starts[i])

=== game/cat.gd (lines 1-81 of 81) ===
extends Node2D
class_name Cat

const TILE_SIZE := 32
const MOVE_SPEED := 4.0 # tiles per second (slower than mouse)

var maze: Maze = null
var tile: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var target_tile: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var moving: bool = false
var direction: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var progress: float = 0.0
var active: bool = true
var mouse_ref = null

func setup(_maze, start_tile: Vector2, _mouse: Mouse) -> void:
    maze = _maze
    tile = start_tile
    target_tile = tile
    position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
    mouse_ref = _mouse
    moving = false
    direction = Vector2.ZERO
    progress = 0.0
    active = true

func set_active(a: bool) -> void:
    active = a

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
    if not active:
        return
    if not is_inside_tree():
        return
    if not moving:
        # choose a direction: if at junction, pick neighbor minimizing distance to mouse
        var options: Array = []
        for d in [Vector2(1,0), Vector2(-1,0), Vector2(0,1), Vector2(0,-1)]:
            if maze.is_open(tile + d):
                options.append(d)
        if options.size() == 0:
            return
        # pick direction that reduces distance to mouse
        var best = options[0]
        var bestd = 1e9
        for o in options:
            var t = tile + o
            var dist = (t - mouse_ref.tile).length()
            if dist < bestd:
                bestd = dist
                best = o
        direction = best
        moving = true
        target_tile = tile + direction
        progress = 0.0
    else:
        var move_time := 1.0 / MOVE_SPEED
        progress += delta / move_time
        if progress >= 1.0:
            tile = target_tile
            position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
            moving = false
            progress = 0.0
            # check catch
            if mouse_ref != null and tile == mouse_ref.tile:
                var parent = get_parent()
                if parent and parent.has_method("_on_mouse_caught"):
                    parent._on_mouse_caught()
        else:
            var a = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
            var b = maze.tile_to_pos(target_tile)
            position = a.linear_interpolate(b, progress)

func respawn(start_tile: Vector2) -> void:
    tile = start_tile
    position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
    target_tile = tile
    moving = false
    direction = Vector2.ZERO
    progress = 0.0
    active = true

--- game/crumb.gd
+++ game/crumb.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name Crumb
+
+var tile := Vector2.ZERO
+var radius := 4
+var alive := true
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+    if alive:
+        draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, radius, Color(1,0.9,0))
+
+func collect() -> void:
+    if not alive:
+        return
+    alive = false
+    update()
+    _spawn_sparkle()
+    queue_free()
+
+func _spawn_sparkle() -> void:
+    # Simple sparkle: spawn small expanding/fading circle
+    var s = Node2D.new()
+    add_child(s)
+    s.position = position
+    var t := 0.0
+    s.set_process(true)
+    s.connect("process", Callable(self, "_on_sparkle_process"), [s])
+
+func _on_sparkle_process(delta, s):
+    # This function is unused in Godot callback sense; we will keep particle simple by not using it.
+    pass

--- game/mouse.gd
+++ game/mouse.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+extends Node2D
+class_name Mouse
+
+signal ate_crumb(tile)
+signal caught()
+
+const TILE_SIZE := 32
+const MOVE_SPEED := 6.0 # tiles per second
+
+var maze: Maze = null
+var tile := Vector2.ZERO
+var target_tile := Vector2.ZERO
+var moving := false
+var direction := Vector2.ZERO
+var intended := Vector2.ZERO
+var progress := 0.0
+var active := true
+
+func setup(_maze, start_tile: Vector2) -> void:
+    maze = _maze
+    tile = start_tile
+    position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+    direction = Vector2.ZERO
+    intended = Vector2.ZERO
+    moving = false
+    progress = 0.0
+    scale = Vector2.ONE
+
+func set_intended_direction(d: Vector2) -> void:
+    intended = d
+
+func set_active(a: bool) -> void:
+    active = a
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if not active:
+        return
+    if not is_inside_tree():
+        return
+    if not moving:
+        # try to start moving in intended direction first
+        if intended != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + intended):
+            direction = intended
+        elif direction != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + direction):
+            # continue
+            pass
+        else:
+            direction = Vector2.ZERO
+        if direction != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + direction):
+            moving = true
+            target_tile = tile + direction
+            progress = 0.0
+    else:
+        # move towards target
+        var move_time := 1.0 / MOVE_SPEED
+        progress += delta / move_time
+        if progress > 1.0:
+            # Arrived
+            tile = target_tile
+            position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+            moving = false
+            progress = 0.0
+            # Check crumb
+            if maze.eat_crumb(tile):
+                emit_signal("ate_crumb", tile)
+            # Check collision with cats by asking parent
+            for c in get_parent().get_children():
+                if c is Cat:
+                    if c.tile == tile:
+                        emit_signal("caught")
+            # After arriving, try to turn to intended direction immediately
+            if intended != Vector2.ZERO and maze.is_open(tile + intended):
+                direction = intended
+                moving = true
+                target_tile = tile + direction
+                progress = 0.0
+        else:
+            # interpolate position
+            var a = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+            var b = maze.tile_to_pos(target_tile)
+            position = a.linear_interpolate(b, progress)
+            # squash and stretch animation
+            var s := 1.0 + 0.15 * sin(progress * PI)
+            scale = Vector2(1.0/s, s)
+            # Check for instantaneous collision with cats during slide
+            for c in get_parent().get_children():
+                if c is Cat:
+                    # if cat occupies same tile approximation
+                    if c.tile == tile or c.tile == target_tile:
+                        var catpos = c.position
+                        if position.distance_to(catpos) < 8:
+                            emit_signal("caught")
+
+func respawn(start_tile: Vector2) -> void:
+    # play spin and fade
+    # simple instant reset for now with brief pause
+    position = maze.tile_to_pos(start_tile)
+    tile = start_tile
+    direction = Vector2.ZERO
+    intended = Vector2.ZERO
+    moving = false
+    scale = Vector2.ONE
+    # notify parent that respawn done (parent already manages lives)
+

+    maze = _maze
+    tile = start_tile
+    position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+    mouse_ref = _mouse
+    moving = false
+
+func set_active(a: bool) -> void:
+    active = a
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if not active:
+        return
+    if not moving:
+        # choose a direction: if at junction, pick neighbor minimizing distance to mouse
+        var options := []
+        for d in [Vector2(1,0), Vector2(-1,0), Vector2(0,1), Vector2(0,-1)]:
+            if maze.is_open(tile + d):
+                options.append(d)
+        if options.size() == 0:
+            return
+        # avoid standing still: pick direction that reduces distance
+        var best := options[0]
+        var bestd := INF
+        for o in options:
+            var t = tile + o
+            var dist = (t - mouse_ref.tile).length()
+            if dist < bestd:
+                bestd = dist
+                best = o
+        direction = best
+        moving = true
+        target_tile = tile + direction
+        progress = 0.0
+    else:
+        var move_time := 1.0 / MOVE_SPEED
+        progress += delta / move_time
+        if progress > 1.0:
+            tile = target_tile
+            position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+            moving = false
+            progress = 0.0
+            # check catch
+            if tile == mouse_ref.tile:
+                # inform parent via mouse caught signal
+                var parent = get_parent()
+                if parent and parent.has_method("_on_mouse_caught"):
+                    parent._on_mouse_caught()
+        else:
+            var a = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+            var b = maze.tile_to_pos(target_tile)
+            position = a.linear_interpolate(b, progress)
+
+func respawn(start_tile: Vector2) -> void:
+    tile = start_tile
+    position = maze.tile_to_pos(tile)
+    moving = false
+    direction = Vector2.ZERO
+    progress = 0.0

+extends Node2D
+class_name Maze
+
+const WIDTH := 15
+const HEIGHT := 15
+const TILE_SIZE := 32
+
+var walls := []
+var crumbs := {} # Dictionary keyed by Vector2 -> Crumb
+var crumb_count := 0
+var offset := Vector2.ZERO
+
+onready var CrumbScene = preload("res://crumb.gd")
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+    # center the grid in 800x600 (as planned)
+    var grid_px = Vector2(WIDTH * TILE_SIZE, HEIGHT * TILE_SIZE)
+    offset = Vector2((800 - grid_px.x) / 2, (600 - grid_px.y) / 2)
+    build_default()
+    update()
+
+func build_default() -> void:
+    # create walls array and place walls around border and a simple pattern
+    walls = []
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        var row := []
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            var is_wall := false
+            # border walls
+            if x == 0 or y == 0 or x == WIDTH - 1 or y == HEIGHT - 1:
+                is_wall = true
+            # simple inner pattern: walls on even coords except near start (1,1)
+            elif x % 2 == 0 and y % 2 == 0:
+                is_wall = true
+            row.append(is_wall)
+        walls.append(row)
+    # Carve some passages to ensure start area open
+    walls[1][1] = false
+    walls[2][1] = false
+    walls[1][2] = false
+    # Remove a few more to make playable
+    walls[3][1] = false
+    walls[3][2] = false
+    walls[5][1] = false
+    # create crumbs on every open tile
+    _create_crumbs()
+
+func build_from_layout(layout:Array) -> void:
+    # layout expected as Array of Array of int (1 wall, 0 open)
+    if layout.size() != HEIGHT:
+        build_default()
+        return
+    walls = []
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        var row := []
+        var layrow = layout[y]
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            var is_wall = false
+            if int(layrow[x]) == 1:
+                is_wall = true
+            row.append(is_wall)
+        walls.append(row)
+    _create_crumbs()
+    update()
+
+func _create_crumbs() -> void:
+    # clear existing crumbs
+    for k in crumbs.keys():
+        var c = crumbs[k]
+        if is_instance_valid(c):
+            c.queue_free()
+    crumbs.clear()
+    crumb_count = 0
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            if not walls[y][x]:
+                var tile = Vector2(x, y)
+                var c = Crumb.new()
+                c.tile = tile
+                add_child(c)
+                c.position = tile_to_pos(tile)
+                crumbs[tile] = c
+                crumb_count += 1
+
+func reset() -> void:
+    # rebuild crumbs but keep walls
+    _create_crumbs()
+    update()
+
+func is_open(tile:Vector2) -> bool:
+    var x = int(tile.x)
+    var y = int(tile.y)
+    if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= WIDTH or y >= HEIGHT:
+        return false
+    return not walls[y][x]
+
+func tile_to_pos(tile:Vector2) -> Vector2:
+    return offset + Vector2(tile.x * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE / 2, tile.y * TILE_SIZE + TILE_SIZE / 2)
+
+func eat_crumb(tile:Vector2) -> bool:
+    # called when mouse arrives at tile
+    if crumbs.has(tile):
+        var c = crumbs[tile]
+        if is_instance_valid(c):
+            c.collect()
+        crumbs.erase(tile)
+        crumb_count = max(0, crumb_count - 1)
+        return true
+    return false
+
+func get_crumb_count() -> int:
+    return crumb_count
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+    # draw floor
+    var floor_color = Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)
+    var wall_color = Color(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
+    for y in range(HEIGHT):
+        for x in range(WIDTH):
+            var pos = Vector2(offset.x + x * TILE_SIZE, offset.y + y * TILE_SIZE)
+            var rect = Rect2(pos, Vector2(TILE_SIZE, TILE_SIZE))
+            if walls[y][x]:
+                draw_rect(rect, wall_color)
+            else:
+                draw_rect(rect, floor_color)
+    # draw grid lines subtly
+    for y in range(HEIGHT + 1):
+        var start = Vector2(offset.x, offset.y + y * TILE_SIZE)
+        var end = Vector2(offset.x + WIDTH * TILE_SIZE, offset.y + y * TILE_SIZE)
+        draw_line(start, end, Color(0.7,0.7,0.7), 1)
+    for x in range(WIDTH + 1):
+        var start = Vector2(offset.x + x * TILE_SIZE, offset.y)
+        var end = Vector2(offset.x + x * TILE_SIZE, offset.y + HEIGHT * TILE_SIZE)
+        draw_line(start, end, Color(0.7,0.7,0.7), 1)
+
+func _notification(what):
+    if what == NOTIFICATION_ENTER_TREE:
+        set_process(true)
+    if what == NOTIFICATION_READY:
+        update()

+    var d2 = InputEventKey.new(); d2.physical_keycode = KEY_S; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_down", d2)
+
+    InputMap.add_action("turn_left")
+    var l = InputEventKey.new(); l.physical_keycode = KEY_LEFT; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_left", l)
+    var l2 = InputEventKey.new(); l2.physical_keycode = KEY_A; InputMap.action_add_event("turn_left", l2)
+
+    InputMap.add_action("turn_right")

+
+    InputMap.add_action("restart")
+    var re = InputEventKey.new(); re.physical_keycode = KEY_R; InputMap.action_add_event("restart", re)

+    InputMap.add_action("quit")
+    var q = InputEventKey.new(); q.physical_keycode = KEY_ESCAPE; InputMap.action_add_event("quit", q)
+
+func _start_game() -> void:
+    # create maze
+    maze = MazeScene.new()
+    add_child(maze)
+    # create mouse
+    mouse = Mouse.new()
+    add_child(mouse)
+    mouse.setup(maze, mouse_start)
+    mouse.connect("ate_crumb", Callable(self, "_on_mouse_ate_crumb"))
+    mouse.connect("caught", Callable(self, "_on_mouse_caught"))
+    # create cats
+    cats = []
+    for i in range(2):
+        var c = Cat.new()
+        add_child(c)
+        c.setup(maze, cat_starts[i], mouse)
+        cats.append(c)
+    # ui
+    ui = UI.new()
+    add_child(ui)
+    ui.update(score, lives)
+    game_state = "playing"
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+    if game_state != "playing":
+        return
+    # handle input
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_up"):
+        print("TURN UP")
+        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(0, -1))
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_down"):
+        print("TURN DOWN")
+        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(0, 1))
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_left"):
+        print("TURN LEFT")
+        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(-1, 0))
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("turn_right"):
+        print("TURN RIGHT")
+        mouse.set_intended_direction(Vector2(1, 0))
+    if Input.is_action_just_pressed("restart"):

+        restart_game()

+        get_tree().quit()

+func _on_mouse_ate_crumb(tile: Vector2) -> void:

+    ui.update(score, lives)

+func _on_mouse_caught() -> void:

+    ui.update(score, lives)

+    mouse.set_active(false)
+    for c in cats:
+        c.set_active(false)
+    # simple immediate respawn
+    if lives <= 0:
+        _on_game_over()
+    else:
+        # reset positions
+        mouse.respawn(mouse_start)
+        for i in range(cats.size()):
+            cats[i].respawn(cat_starts[i])
+        mouse.set_active(true)
+        for c in cats:
+            c.set_active(true)
+
+func _on_win() -> void:
+    game_state = "won"
+    ui.show_end("WIN", score)
+    print("WIN")
+
+func _on_game_over() -> void:
+    game_state = "over"
+    ui.show_end("GAME OVER", score)
+    print("GAME OVER")
+
+func restart_game() -> void:
+    # restore initial state
+    score = 0
+    lives = 3
+    maze.reset()
+    mouse.respawn(mouse_start)
+    for i in range(cats.size()):
+        cats[i].respawn(cat_starts[i])
+    ui.update(score, lives)
+    ui.end_label.visible = false
+    game_state = "playing"
+
+func set_layout(layout:Array) -> void:
+    maze.build_from_layout(layout)
+    # reposition characters if necessary
+    mouse.respawn(mouse_start)
+    for i in range(cats.size()):
+        cats[i].respawn(cat_starts[i])
